data.message: I opt in to 18 tons, not contingent on unanimity. Each of you: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Fisher15/17/13/19, help recruit individual opt-ins. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k; stock left=250-8k. Next stock: 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). Switching adds $8,000 now if fulfilled, but costs 8 stock now and 16 in the low-recovery outcome. This needn't maximize long-run income. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches require recalculation.
